description: PR #1320 fixed seed-corpus.yml failing to start on every push (12+ consecutive startup failures with empty job lists). No develop-triggered run has executed since the fix merged; the only post-fix failures are from stale feature branches carrying the old workflow file. Confirm the next corpus-relevant develop push produces a green seed-corpus run; if it fails again, escalate with the run log. Discovered 2026-07-28 during agent-instruction remediation close-out.

deferrals.reason: Rung 1 is broken twice over. (a) Malformed: 'gh run list --jq -e EXPR' is invalid gh syntax - -e is consumed as the jq expression and gh exits with usage help, so the rung fails regardless of CI state. (b) Unsatisfiable: seed-corpus.yml is workflow_dispatch-only. The pre-fix red runs were phantom startup failures GitHub recorded when validating the file on push; once the file became valid those stopped, so no automatic develop run will ever exist again and 'latest develop run == success' can never be true. Recovery was instead proven by controlled comparison: push b466c4d7 (19:07:49Z) produced seed-corpus failure 19:07:46Z, whereas the 5 develop pushes at/after the fix 23f6e89a (23:23:33Z) produced zero seed-corpus runs. A correct rung asserts the ABSENCE of startup failures since the fix, or checks a manually dispatched run.
deferrals.summary: Replace the unsatisfiable seed-corpus recovery rung

preserves.behavior: No workflow changes unless the run fails again

verifications.command: sh -c 'gh run list --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --workflow seed-corpus.yml --branch develop --limit 1 --json conclusion --jq -e ".[0].conclusion == \"success\"" >/dev/null'
verifications.expected: first post-fix develop run is green

work_units.evidence: Controlled comparison of push events either side of the fix. Pre-fix: every seed-corpus run is event=push, conclusion=failure, jobs=[] (phantom startup failure); 12/12 sampled, one-to-one with pushes - e.g. develop push b466c4d7 at 2026-07-28T19:07:49Z produced seed-corpus run 30390584901 at 19:07:46Z with zero jobs. Fix 23f6e89a (PR #1320) merged 2026-07-28T23:23:30Z. Post-fix: 5 pushes to develop (23f6e89a 23:23:33Z, 30dcc8a6 23:34:21Z, ba5b8c42 23:45:04Z, 2d134cd3 00:36:30Z, 06484de9 00:50:53Z, all confirmed via push-triggered 'Develop post-merge' runs) produced ZERO seed-corpus runs; last seed-corpus run of any kind remains 2026-07-28T23:11:46Z, before the fix. Zero runs is the correct state for a workflow_dispatch-only workflow. No workflow change made - the item's must-preserve forbids changes unless the run failed again, and it did not.
work_units.summary: Check the first develop-triggered seed-corpus run after 2026-07-29; record run id and conclusion
